actual: After full-market production adj_factor reconciliation job 66711159-7165-4212-9a1d-c95df3685e41, the immutable r4 QE candidate differs on 4,904 provider symbols and 1,842,557 daily factor cells. The canonical monthly CLI only performs component-wide rebuilds and cannot create a new immutable candidate by rebuilding only affected stock/date outputs while preserving byte-identical unaffected files. Add a data-owned, fail-closed selective producer and tests; it must never modify the baseline candidate, active profile, QE model/runtime, DB, services, or unrelated components.
